description: Curated public summary of a learner's SPEC profile, written by spec-server (singleton, key literal:self). Exposes human-readable level, settled counts, and growth zone — not raw BKT posteriors, thresholds, or per-item model state. See docs/learner-data-architecture.md.

specDecimal.description: Optional display decimal (level + progress toward next level).

eloRating.description: Optional overall ELO trajectory score mirror; canonical ELO lives in tools.spec.profile.elo.

settledLemmas.description: Count of lemma families considered settled for the current level.

settledMorphemes.description: Count of morpheme patterns considered settled for the current level.

settledDomains.description: Count of content domains with sufficient settled encounters.

weeksAtLevel.description: Consecutive weeks at or above the current level thresholds.

growthZoneLow.description: Lower bound of the learner's recommended E_diff growth window.

growthZoneHigh.description: Upper bound of the learner's recommended E_diff growth window.
